name: zcode-token-meter-mac
description: TokenMeter for ZCode (macOS) — floating tok/s + cache hit widget

plugins.name: zcode-token-meter-mac
plugins.description: Floating always-on-top macOS widget showing live ZCode token speed (tok/s or tok/min) and prompt-cache hit rate, read locally from ZCode's SQLite DB. No network, no telemetry.

description_i18n.en: Floating always-on-top macOS widget showing live ZCode token speed (tok/s or tok/min) and prompt-cache hit rate, read locally from ZCode's SQLite DB. No network, no telemetry.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 悬浮置顶的 macOS 小组件，实时显示 ZCode 的 Token 生成速度（tok/s 或 tok/min）与提示词缓存命中率，数据来自本地 SQLite 数据库。无网络请求、无遥测。
